supported_scope: Native App discovery of workspace, directory-scoped and global rule files, with documented activation modes and precedence. Rules supply agent context rather than an access-control boundary.
required_setup: Create supported rule files or use App Customizations; activation depends on file type and trigger.
constraints: Rule size and aggregate-context limits apply; invalid triggers can prevent loading.
